• The word **"Verifibility"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is** "Verifiability"** which means the quality of being able to be checked or demonstrated to be true, accurate, or justified. (सत्यापन क्षमता)

 
 
• **Example: **The** verifiability** of the experiment's results was crucial for its acceptance by the scientific community.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"Verifiability"**. (सत्यापन क्षमता)
 
 
• **Example: **The **verifiability** of the data ensures that the research findings can be trusted.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Verminous** (जूं से भरा हुआ): Relating to or resembling vermin; infested with or affected by vermin.

 
 
• **Example:** The old, verminous building was finally torn down by the city.
 
 
 
• **Vomitus** (उल्टी): Matter that has been vomited; vomit.
 
 
• **Example:** The nurse carefully cleaned up the patient's vomitus.
 
 
 
• **Voluptuous** (कामुक): Characterized by luxury or sensual pleasure.
 
 
• **Example:** The actress was known for her voluptuous figure and elegant style.
